## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Medellín, Colombia. It starts at Cra. 52 ##20-63, Antioquia.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Fast-track your way to furry-town and hang with the animals at Parque de la Conservación. From butterflies to snakes and spider monkeys, it's an educational day out which also contributes to the conservation of biodiversity in South America.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €11.96. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 233 ratings and 104 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
